name: A Forest Exclusive Wing Gives a Sound Inverse Construction
statement: Under the structural and positive-section hypotheses of the one-relative-wing inverse theorem, it is enough that one induced exclusive-wing graph $G(B_i\setminus O)$ be a forest. The resulting expansion is an ample forbidden pc-minor and its marked data are recovered from the expansion.
proof: For nonempty nested ample families $O\subseteq B_i$, the relative Yang module is Cohen--Macaulay. The relative forest linear-quotients theorem supplies an $O$-relative ample addition chain in $B_i$; reversing it peels $B_i$ to $O$. The one-relative-wing inverse theorem then applies.
